data.name: 7 Days to Escape
data.detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE PRISON

You are a defective clone trapped inside a brutal prison where every day follows a strict routine.

Obey the guards. Complete your shifts. Stay in order. Avoid suspicion.

But survival is not only about following the rules.

Every seven days, the prison gang demands payment. Fail to pay, and the consequences will be deadly. To survive, you must work, loot, hide contraband, enter restricted zones, and slowly prepare your escape.

The prison was built to control you.

Now you must find a way out.

PAY THE GANG EVERY SEVEN DAYS

Money is survival.

Work your assigned shifts, search for valuable items, and gather enough resources before the deadline arrives. The gang does not forgive debt, and every week becomes more dangerous than the last.

Play it safe and follow the prison routine, or take bigger risks by sneaking into restricted areas for better loot.

ENTER THE RESTRICTED ZONES

Some areas of the prison are locked away for a reason.

Restricted zones contain rare items, useful tools, hidden secrets, and valuable loot that can help you survive or escape. But these areas are dangerous, and the deeper you go, the more the prison begins to reveal what is really hidden inside.

The guards are not the only threat.

Something is wrong in this facility.

DIG YOUR WAY OUT

Your cell is more than a place to sleep.

Use it as the start of your escape plan. Dig a tunnel, hide your progress, collect tools, and slowly create a path toward freedom.

Every mistake can expose your plan.

Every night can bring you closer to escape.

FIND THE KEYS. OPEN THE WAY. ESCAPE.

Escaping the prison will not be simple.

Search for keys, steal important items, avoid guards, hide contraband, and plan your route carefully. Every decision matters, and every risk can either bring you closer to freedom or end your run.

The prison is watching.

The gang is waiting.

And something worse is hiding in the dark.

FEATURES

• Prison survival simulation with daily routines and strict rules

• Play as a defective human clone trapped inside a futuristic facility

• Seven-day pressure system where the gang demands payment

• prison shifts and stay compliant

• Sneak into restricted zones filled with loot, danger, and secrets

• Dig a tunnel from your cell and plan your escape

• Collect keys and unlock new paths through the prison

• Dark horror atmosphere with terrifying encounters

• Co-op survival gameplay where teamwork can mean the difference between escape and death

OBEY OR ESCAPE

You can follow the rules and survive another day.

Or you can break them, enter the restricted zones, dig beneath the prison, and risk everything for freedom.

The prison was built to hold clones like you.

Prove it can fail.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 20H2) or Better
  • Processor: Ryzen 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 with 4gb of ram or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 20H2) or Better
  • Processor: Ryzen 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 with 6gb ram or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:

This game is intended for mature audiences only and contains the following content:

Intense violence and gore: Characters may be killed in graphic and bloody ways.
Disturbing imagery: Players may encounter disturbing images and scenes.
Jump scares: The game features sudden and loud noises and events that may startle or frighten players.
